{{Top|leg}}
A '''New Republic Weapon Class III permit''' was a legal document issued by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Individuals wishing to buy a [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav Technologies]] [[Sure-Sight]] had to be in possession of Class III permit before being allowed to purchase one.
